Definition: from G575 and a compound of G1223 and G3724; to disjoin (by a boundary, figuratively, a party):--separate.
BiblicalUsage: Once, about those who separate themselves — sensual, having not the Spirit. Jude's word is for the dividers in the church, who draw their own boundary and stand outside it.
TheologicalSignificance: One verse names the test of every divider: not their arguments, but whether the Spirit is in them.
